# Fig1C

```{r}

# Define cell phenotype markers 
type_markers <- c("CD3", "CD4", "CD8a", "CD20", "SOX10", "CD45", "CSK-III", 
                  "CD31", "D2-40", "CD11c", "CD15", "CD68", "CD169", "CD163", 
                  "CD14", "Coll-I", "FoxP3", "CD45RA", "TOX", "TCF1", "Ki-67", "HLA-DR", "PD-1", "CTLA-4", "GranzymeB")
state_markers = NA

# Add to spe
rowData(spe)$marker_class <- ifelse(rownames(spe) %in% type_markers, "type",
                                    ifelse(rownames(spe) %in% state_markers, "state", 
                                    "other"))

```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(tidyverse)
library(imcRtools)
library(cytomapper)
library(scuttle)
set.seed(22)

### 1. Heatmap bodies ###

# Heatmap body color 
col_exprs <- colorRamp2(c(0,1,2,3), 
                        c("#440154FF","#20938CFF",
                          "#6ACD5AFF","#FDE725FF"))

# By cell type markers
celltype_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(as(spe, "SingleCellExperiment"),  
                     ids = spe$celltype_level2, 
                     statistics = "mean",
                     use.assay.type = "exprs", 
                     subset.row = rownames(spe)[rowData(spe)$marker_class == "type"])

h_type <- Heatmap(scale(t(assay(celltype_mean, "exprs"))),
        column_title = "markers",
        col=colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3), c("#005f73", "white", "#ae2012")),
        name= "Z-score", cluster_rows = T,
        show_row_names = TRUE, 
        show_column_names = TRUE)

x <- Heatmap(scale(t(assay(celltype_mean, "exprs"))),
        column_title = "markers",
        col= col_exprs, 
        name= "mean exprs",
        show_row_names = TRUE, 
        show_column_names = TRUE)

### 2.1  Metadata features

anno <- colData(celltype_mean) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(celltype_level2, ncells)

# Proportion of indication per celltype
indication <- unclass(prop.table(table(spe$celltype_level2, spe$Group), margin = 1))

# Number of contributing patients per celltype
cluster_PID <- colData(spe) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    dplyr::select(celltype_level2, Patient.ID) %>% 
    group_by(celltype_level2) %>% table() %>% 
    as.data.frame()

n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% 
    filter(Freq>0) %>% 
    group_by(celltype_level2) %>% 
    count(name = "n_PID") %>% 
    column_to_rownames("celltype_level2")

# Create HeatmapAnnotation objects
ha_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(celltype_level2 = anno$celltype_level2,
                            border = TRUE, 
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            col = list(celltype_level2 = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$celltype_level2),
                            which = "row")

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(anno$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm")),
                            n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm")),
                            indication = anno_barplot(indication,width = unit(10, "mm"),
                                                      gp = gpar(fill = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$Group)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 2.2 Spatial features

# Add number of neighbors to spe object (saved in colPair)
spe$n_neighbors <- countLnodeHits(colPair(spe, "neighborhood"))

# Select spatial features and average over celltypes
spatial <- colData(spe) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    dplyr::select(AreaShape_Area, celltype_level2, n_neighbors)

spatial <- spatial %>% 
    dplyr::select(-celltype_level2) %>% 
    aggregate(by = list(celltype_level2 = spatial$celltype_level2), FUN = mean) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("celltype_level2")

# Create HeatmapAnnotation object
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$AreaShape_Area,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors,
    border = TRUE,
    gap = unit(1,"mm"),
    which = "row")

### 3. Plot rich heatmap ###

# Create HeatmapList object
h_list <- 
    h_type +
    ha_anno +
    ha_spatial +
    ha_meta

# Add customized legend for anno_barplot()
lgd <- Legend(title = "indication", 
              at = colnames(indication), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$Group))

# Plot
draw(h_list,annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))

```

## Fig 1D

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstatix)

df <- unique(as.data.frame(table(spe$ID, spe$celltype_level2)))
colnames(df) <- c("ID", "celltype", "Freq")

df$Patient.ID <- spe$Patient.ID[match(df$ID, spe$ID)]
df$Group <- spe$Group[match(df$ID, spe$ID)]
df$Location <- spe$Location[match(df$ID, spe$ID)]
df$Group.location <- spe$Group.location[match(df$ID, spe$ID)]
df$Cells_per_mm2 <- df$Freq * 4
df <- subset(df, Patient.ID != "Patient01_Ctrl")
```

```{r,  fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
vol.input <- df %>%
  group_by(ID, celltype, Location, Group) 


ls <- list()

for(cell in unique(spe$celltype_level2)){
  
  filtered_data <- subset(vol.input, celltype == cell)
  
  pwc <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  t_test(Cells_per_mm2 ~ Group)
  
  pwc.filter <- subset(pwc, group1 == "S3_DF" & group2 == "S3_R")
  pwc.filter$celltype <- cell
  
  ls[[cell]] <- pwc.filter
}

ls.2 <- rbindlist(ls, fill=TRUE)
ls.2$Location.celltype <- paste0(ls.2$Location,"_", ls.2$celltype) 

counts <- vol.input %>%
  group_by(celltype, Location, Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(counts = mean(Cells_per_mm2))

counts_DF = subset(counts, Group == "S3_DF")
counts_DF$Location.celltype <- paste0(counts_DF$Location,"_", counts_DF$celltype) 

counts_R = subset(counts, Group == "S3_R")
counts_R$Location.celltype <- paste0(counts_R$Location,"_", counts_R$celltype)

###

# Use the left_join function to merge the dataframes based on Location.celltype
merged_df <- left_join(ls.2, counts_DF, by = "Location.celltype")

# Update the ls.2$group1_counts column with counts from counts_DF
ls.2 <- merged_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Location.y, Group)) %>%  # Remove the counts column, if desired
  rename(group1_counts = counts)  # Rename the column to group1_counts, if needed

# Use the left_join function to merge the dataframes based on Location.celltype
merged_df <- left_join(ls.2, counts_R, by = "Location.celltype")

# Update the ls.2$group1_counts column with counts from counts_DF
ls.2 <- merged_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Location, Group)) %>%  # Remove the counts column, if desired
  rename(group2_counts = counts)  # Rename the column to group1_counts, if needed

ls.2$L2Fchange <- log2(ls.2$group1_counts+1) - log2(ls.2$group2_counts+1)

library(EnhancedVolcano)

for (i in unique(ls.2$Location.x)){
  
Location = i

    input = as.data.frame(subset(ls.2, Location.x == Location))
    rownames(input) <- input$celltype

      ##### Define custom colors #####
      # set the base colour as grey
      keyvals <- rep('#d3d3d3', nrow(input))

      #set the base name/label as 'NS'
      names(keyvals) <- rep('NS', nrow(input))

      # modify keyvals for variables with fold change > 1 and Padj < 0.05
      keyvals[which(input$L2Fchange > 0 &
                      input$p < 0.05)] <- '#ba181b' #color code
      names(keyvals)[which(input$L2Fchange > 0 &
                             input$p < 0.05)] <- 'DF' #Upregulated genes

      # modify keyvals for variables with fold change < -1
      keyvals[which(input$L2Fchange < 0 &
                      input$p < 0.05)] <- '#1a659e' #color code
      names(keyvals)[which(input$L2Fchange < 0 &
                             input$p < 0.05)] <- 'R' #Downregulated genes
    
     volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(input,
                           lab = input$celltype,         # Labels of your points
                           title = Location,                # Title of your volcanoplot
                           x = "L2Fchange",            # What to plot on the x-axis
                           y = "p",         # What to plot on the y-axis
                           pCutoff = 0.05,            # Adj. P-value cutoff
                           FCcutoff = 0,              # Fold change cutoff
                           #selectLab = c(),          # Write down comma delimited genes to only show these genes
                           drawConnectors = TRUE,     # Draw a connecting line to your label
                           #arrowheads = F,           # Whether the connectors should have a arrowhead
                           #widthConnectors = 0.1,    # How thick the line of the connectors should be
                           #colConnectors = "black",  # Colour of the connectors
                           #boxedLabels = TRUE,       # Draw a box around your label
                           #legendVisible = F,        # standard is TRUE
                           colAlpha = 0.6,            # transparency of points
                           #xlim = c(-4.5, 4.5),      # change axis range
                           ylim = c(0,5.5),           # change axis range
                           pointSize = 3,             # Define size of the dots
                           labSize = 3,            # Define size of the labels
                           gridlines.minor = FALSE,   # Add minor grid to background
                           gridlines.major = FALSE,   # Add major grid to background
                           cutoffLineType = 'dashed',  # Add cutoff lines for Log2Fold/Pval. 
                           cutoffLineCol = "#d3d3d3", # Colour of the cutoff line
                           border = "full",           # Chose "full", "partial" or "blank"
                           borderColour = "black",
                           borderWidth = 0.5,
                           colCustom = keyvals #Add custom colors for your values as defined above 
                           ) #+ coord_flip() #Flip the volcanoplot on its side
    
  
    print(volcano)
}
```

## Fig1E

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(imcRtools)

spe_S3_PC <- subset(spe, (Group == "S3_DF" | Group == "S3_R") & Location == Paracortex)
  
# By celltypes
spe_S3_PC <- aggregateNeighbors(spe_S3_PC, 
                          colPairName = "delaunay_interaction_graph", 
                          aggregate_by = "metadata", 
                          count_by = "celltype_level2")

set.seed(220705)

cn_1 <- kmeans(spe_S3_PC$aggregatedNeighbors, centers = 10, nstart = 100, iter.max = 1000)
spe_S3_PC$k10 <- as.factor(cn_1$cluster)

plotSpatial(spe_S3_PC[1], 
            node_color_by = "k10", 
            img_id = "sample_id", 
            node_size_fix = 1)

saveRDS(spe_S3_PC, "spe_s3_PC_neighbourhoods_K10.rds")
```
